message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to pull in real‑time data from external services such as AirNow or AQICN. To find out the current air quality index (AQI) for Los Angeles you can check one of the following:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” and view the latest AQI. |
| **AQICN** | Go to https://aqicn.org/, search for “Los Angeles” and look at the live map or the city’s page. |
| **EPA’s Air Quality Dashboard** | https://www.epa.gov/outdoor-air-quality-data/air-quality-dashboard – select California → Los Angeles County. |
| **Weather apps** | Many weather apps (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or your phone’s native weather app) display the AQI for your location. |

If you’re looking for historical trends or want to analyze long‑term changes, the EPA’s AirData portal provides downloadable datasets for Los Angeles County.
